scientific_integrity: An unconditional analytical proof is accompanied by exact rational arithmetic for the finite classification; finite checks do not replace the published prime-interval theorem or the infinite subsum lemma.
scientific_limitations: Exact closure and its component endpoints at exponent -3 only; not a theorem about the pointwise range, other parameters, or the distribution of primes beyond the published prime interval bound.
title: Fourteen connected components of the reciprocal-cube unitary-divisor range
